name: active
description: Business Fitness public plugins for Claude Code: Active Platform integrations. Experimental, provided as-is.

plugins.name: active-platform
plugins.description: Find and manage your Active clients and client groups, their documents, and workpaper binders (trial balance / ledger) -- the firm's client book / CRM -- through the Active MCP server. Includes curl-free document I/O: fetch a document to disk, edit it with any tool, and upload it back as a new version, via a small bundled .NET helper. Plus the Workpapers client-queries skill suite. Requires an Active Platform subscription. The .NET 10 runtime is optional: with it, document transfers skip the permission prompt; without it, Claude moves the bytes itself and asks you to approve each transfer.
